name: raindragon-eta
description: How long turns like this one usually take you, as a range from your own past turns, with a live clock in the status line. Flags major Claude incidents.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the estimates off without uninstalling. Off means nothing is shown and nothing is recorded.

band.title: Band width
band.description: 50 shows the middle half of similar past turns, 80 shows the middle 8 in 10 (wider, misses less often).

show_result.title: Show actual time
show_result.description: After each turn, show how long it took next to the band.

check_status.title: Check Claude status
check_status.description: Read status.claude.com (cached 2 minutes) to warn when Claude Code or the API has an incident. Nothing is sent except the request itself.
